Mhaske, Member (ex-officio)** ## ## **And In the matter of** Ishwar Nagar, Okhla Crossing, Mathura Road, New Delhi-110 065 ** ..Petitioner** Jodhpur-342 003 and others Term Loan Facility Agreement and creation and/or perfection of security interest by way of mortgage/ charge/ hypothecation/ assignment over all movable and immovable assets of the Petitioner to secure the outstanding loan by way of security in favour of Security Trustee acting for the benefit and on behalf of the lenders. 2. Case was called out for virtual hearing on 19.3.2021. It was submitted by the learned counsel for the Petitioner that since the Petitioner has repaid the outstanding loan, the present Petition has become infructuous. Accordingly, the learned counsel for the Petitioner sought permission to withdraw the Petition. 3. The prayer of the learned counsel for the Petitioner is allowed. Accordingly, Petition No. 558/MP/2020 is disposed of as withdrawn. **Sd/sd/sd/sd/sd/(P. S. Mhaske) (P.K.Singh) (Arun Goyal ) (I.S.Jha) (P.K.
